datasets: Genshin (Xiangling, Hutao, Mona, Diluc, Venti, Noelle)
outputs: style-converted text outputs preserving original content

changes_made.explanation: Normalized LLaMA2-7B to LLaMA-2-7B. Removed detailed sub-dataset specifications from Genshin and simplified output descriptions to one consistent form.
Normalized metric names to consistent capitalization. Simplified variants (ACC/CP) to full names. Removed SacreBLEU since it's the implementation tool for Self-BLEU.
No LLMs were used as judges - only as generation models. The paper mentions comparing with ChatGPT-4 but only as a baseline generation model, not for evaluation.

guideline: Participants assessed each model based on three criteria: (1) strength of style transfer, (2) semantic integrity, and (3) sentence fluidity. Performances were ranked from best-1 to worst-4.

changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria to match consistent naming from the guideline description. Used the full guideline description as quoted in the paper.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Text Style Transfer (TST) as an NLG task. Extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization for consistency. The paper uses automatic metrics (ACC, CP, Self-BLEU, G-score) and human evaluation with three criteria. No LLMs were used as judges - only ChatGPT-4 was used as a baseline generation model.
